description: Set Text Frame Options on text frames: columns (fixed number, fixed width or flexible width, count, width, maximum, gutter, balance), inset spacing, vertical justification and paragraph spacing limit, ignore text wrap, baseline options and a custom baseline grid, auto-sizing, footnote overrides and column rules (Object > Text Frame Options)

minimumHeight.description: Minimum height in mm (0 turns the minimum off)

minimumWidth.description: Minimum width in mm (0 turns the minimum off)

noLineBreaks.description: No Line Breaks (widen instead of wrapping)

referencePoint.description: The point that stays put while the frame resizes

baseline.description: Baseline Options tab. Setting any grid option turns on the custom baseline grid unless customGrid is false

gridColor.description: Grid colour: a colour name such as "light_blue" or "grid_orange", or "#RRGGBB"

gridRelativeTo.description: What the grid start is measured from

columnRules.description: Column Rules tab. Setting any option turns on Insert Column Rule unless enabled is false

insetChain.description: Keep top and bottom insets the same

offset.description: Horizontal offset in mm from the centre of the gutter

strokeColor.description: A swatch name in the document, or "#RRGGBB" (creates an RGB colour swatch)

strokeType.description: Stroke style name, such as "Solid" or "Dashed"

maxWidth.description: Maximum column width in mm, for flexible width (0 = no limit)

mode.description: Fixed Number keeps the count when the frame is resized, Fixed Width keeps the column width, Flexible Width adds columns past the maximum width

footnotes.description: Footnotes tab. Setting any option turns on Enable Overrides unless enableOverrides is false

enableOverrides.description: Enable Overrides of the document footnote options

minimumSpacing.description: Minimum spacing before the first footnote in mm

ignoreWrap.description: Ignore Text Wrap from other objects

inset.description: Inset Spacing in mm. Give all, or any of top, left, bottom, right (sides not given keep their value)

all.description: The same value on every side, in mm

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

align.description: Align text to the top, centre or bottom, or justify it vertically

paragraphSpacingLimit.description: Paragraph Spacing Limit in mm (for justify)

name: set_text_frame_options
title: Set Text Frame Options
